title: Georges St-Pierre's CE5 sessions bring orbs

tellings.quote: They see orbs in the sky. I was just on the phone with um UFC fighter George St. Pierre and he was like, "I've been doing this and they they show up a lot."

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says he was recently on the phone with Georges St-Pierre, a famous fighter in the UFC, a mixed martial arts league. According to Michels, St-Pierre has been doing CE5, a practice where people meditate in groups to try to call UFOs, and told him "they show up a lot" in the form of glowing orbs in the sky. If true, it would mean anyone could invite these lights to appear.
